// Generated by Loki Host (Core/TutorialInstance.cs). Any edit here is overwritten on the next start.
-	script	LokiTutorial	-1,{
	end;

// A Loki client whispers "NPC:LokiTutorial": "start" when its tutorial begins, "end" when it is over.
OnWhisperGlobal:
	.@name$ = "Loki Tutorial";
	.@id = instance_id(IM_CHAR);
	if (.@id > 0 && instance_live_info(ILI_NAME, .@id) != .@name$)
		end; // the character owns another instance: nothing is touched
	getmapxy(.@m$, .@x, .@y, BL_PC);
	.@src$ = instance_info(.@name$, IIT_ENTER_MAP);
	.@ex = instance_info(.@name$, IIT_ENTER_X);
	.@ey = instance_info(.@name$, IIT_ENTER_Y);
	.@inside = (.@id > 0 && .@m$ == instance_mapname(.@src$, .@id));
	if (@whispervar0$ == "start" || @whispervar0$ == "enter") {
		if (!.@inside) {
			if (compare(.@m$, "#"))
				end; // standing in an instance: not from here
			// where the tutorial gives the character back: where it stands now (a new character: its start point)
			LOKITUT_M$ = .@m$; LOKITUT_X = .@x; LOKITUT_Y = .@y;
		}
		if (.@id <= 0) {
			.@id = instance_create(.@name$, IM_CHAR);
			if (.@id <= 0) {
				if (.@src$ != "") warp .@src$, .@ex, .@ey;
				end;
			}
		}
		.@im$ = instance_mapname(.@src$, .@id);
		if (.@im$ == "") { // the map could not be made
			instance_destroy .@id;
			if (.@src$ != "") warp .@src$, .@ex, .@ey;
			end;
		}
		// a logout, a crash or a lost connection inside saves the character where it came from, never in the copy
		setmapflagnosave .@im$, LOKITUT_M$, LOKITUT_X, LOKITUT_Y;
		setmapflag .@im$, mf_nomemo;
		setmapflag .@im$, mf_noteleport;
		setmapflag .@im$, mf_nowarpto;
		setmapflag .@im$, mf_nobranch;
		instance_enter(.@name$, -1, -1, getcharid(0), .@id);
		end;
	}
	if (@whispervar0$ == "end" || @whispervar0$ == "leave") {
		if (.@inside || (LOKITUT_M$ != "" && .@src$ != "" && .@m$ == .@src$)) {
			if (LOKITUT_M$ == "")
				warp "SavePoint", 0, 0;
			else
				warp LOKITUT_M$, LOKITUT_X, LOKITUT_Y;
		}
		if (.@id > 0)
			instance_destroy .@id;
		LOKITUT_M$ = ""; LOKITUT_X = 0; LOKITUT_Y = 0;
	}
	end;
}
